title: Northwest Hills — Real Neighborhood, Real Community

beats.purpose: Establish Northwest Hills as a genuine, old-school neighborhood through lifelong resident Chad Adams.

clips.why: Show Chad Adams on camera as he introduces the character of Northwest Hills.
Cut to the iconic Mesa Drive and North Hills Drive neighborhood street signpost.

bed.why: Chad Adams describes how Northwest Hills embodies a genuine, old-school neighborhood.

beats.purpose: Highlight the small-town community atmosphere and scenic green valley described by resident Adrienne Calhoun.

clips.why: Show Adrienne Calhoun speaking on camera about the small-town community.
Cut to a steady wide vista of the lush valley and hillside homes.

bed.why: Adrienne Calhoun reflects on the small-town neighborhood feel and beauty of the area.

beats.purpose: Showcase the unpretentious and friendly spirit of Northwest Hills through local business owner Austin Stone.

clips.why: Show Austin Stone speaking on camera about the community vibe.
Cut to stabilized b-roll of tree-lined residential roads nestled into the hills.

bed.why: Austin Stone shares how welcoming and unstuffy Northwest Hills is compared to other high-end areas.

beats.purpose: Land on the deep community roots and mutual support that define Northwest Hills with Hunter Malloy.

clips.why: Show Hunter Malloy speaking on camera about community representation and support.
Cut to a broad scenic view across the Northwest Hills neighborhood canopy.

bed.why: Hunter Malloy concludes with their tight-knit commitment to supporting neighbors and local youth.
